title: Build-Log Bracket Checker
summary: A CI system flags build-log lines with broken brackets. Fix lines with unclosed brackets passing, point at the first error while ignoring quoted text, then check a two-million-character line.
followUps: Why did most tests pass even though unclosed brackets were accepted?
Why is a stack the right structure here, and what does a counter per bracket type get wrong?
What is the cost of firstError for a line of n characters, and how much memory can it need?
Single quotes and comments starting with // should also hide brackets. How would you extend the scanner without making it hard to follow?
What did the assistant get wrong or leave out, and how did you notice?
